summary: WhatsApp gap from Workshop ewatrade/assistant/conversations v2 (revision 378e5ca2), scene v-review. A voice-note transcript review is now sent with two reply buttons, Use transcript and Cancel transcript (when the body fits WhatsApp's 1024-character interactive limit; longer transcripts keep typed replies). Tapped buttons (wa-voice:use / wa-voice:cancel, bound to the tapped message's context id) become the same voice_choice inbox content as the typed replies, so the existing review consumption, expiry and authority checks decide. Edit stays a typed reply (Edit transcript: plus the corrected text). The review copy is shorter: check the transcript, tap a button or reply to edit, nothing runs until you choose. Local only; media and voice stay off in Production; no provider, OTP or deployment change.
noAssistantImpact: Channel transport only. Button ids carry no authority and map to the existing voice choice schema; no tool, prompt, capability or write changes.

evidence.result: Buttons map to use/cancel only with the tapped message id; titles fit 20 characters. With packages/db assistant-whatsapp unit tests: 74 pass, 1 fail (media-review.test.ts 'Cancel guessed' expects invalid_action from the typed action parser, unchanged since 23 Oct and failing before this change).
Copy assertion updated to the new review text in this file and the two ingest-audio integration tests; not run (QA_ACCESS_ACCEPTANCE_DATABASE_HOST not configured).
